claims.text: Either party can terminate the agreement for convenience, without cause, on 30 days' written notice.

citations.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause at any time effective upon thirty (30) days' written notice.

claims.text: Termination does not relieve the Customer of its obligation to pay all amounts due, including payments made on a timely basis.

citations.quote: no termination of this Agreement for any reason whatsoever shall relieve the Customer of the obligation to pay all amounts due to i-on and to make such payments on a timely basis.

claims.text: Separately, the agreement auto-renews for one-month periods unless either party gives notice of non-renewal not less than fifteen days before the end of the current term. This is a non-renewal mechanism, distinct from termination for convenience.

which notice must be given not less than fifteen (15) days before the end of the respective initial or renewal term.
